mapper.select: SELECT r.ID AS REL_ID, d.ID AS RECORD_ID, v.ID AS VERSION_ID, s.NAME AS SYSTEM_NAME, d.SOURCE_RECORD_KEY, d.STABLE_RECORD_ID, r.TYPE AS REL_TYPE, r.EFFECTIVE_TIME, d.LAST_RECEIVE_TIME, v.MODEL_DATA FROM MASTER_SOURCE_REL r JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_DATA d ON d.ID = r.SOURCE_RECORD_ID AND d.MODEL_ID = r.MODEL_ID JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM s ON s.ID = d.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_DATA_VERSION v ON v.ID = r.SOURCE_VERSION_ID AND v.SOURCE_RECORD_ID = d.ID WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId} AND r.STATUS = '1' AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND d.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND d.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND s.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND s.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND v.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND v.DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY r.EFFECTIVE_TIME DESC, r.ID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT s.ID, s.NAME FROM MASTER_SOURCE_REL r INNER JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_DATA d ON d.ID = r.SOURCE_RECORD_ID AND d.MODEL_ID = r.MODEL_ID AND d.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND d.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM s ON s.ID = d.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID AND s.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND s.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.STATUS = '1' AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY s.NAME, s.ID

SELECT DISTINCT r.MASTER_RECORD_ID FROM MASTER_SOURCE_REL r INNER JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_DATA d ON d.ID = r.SOURCE_RECORD_ID AND d.MODEL_ID = r.MODEL_ID AND d.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND d.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM s ON s.ID = d.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID AND s.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND s.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.STATUS = '1' AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND s.ID = #{sourceSystemId}
